If you are concerned about either of these conditions, it is best to speak with your healthcare provider. They can assess your individual situation and provide personalized recommendations for your health and wellbeing.

Excessive daytime sleepiness is a common symptom of OSA and can be quantified using the Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS). The STOP-BANG questionnaire is commonly used to screen for OSA and can help determine the likelihood of moderate-to-severe OSA. The patient's age, BMI, neck circumference, snoring, and daytime sleepiness should be considered when assessing the risk of OSA.
